## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Focus on why this change was made and how it impacts the PulsePay protocol or the SEP-24 integration.

Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Smart Contract modification (Requires re-deployment and SDK update)
- [ ] Documentation update (Nextra site or README)

## Testing Strategy

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. 

- [ ] Playwright E2E tests pass locally (`pnpm test:e2e`)
- [ ] Rust Soroban contract tests pass (`cargo test`)
- [ ] Next.js frontend builds without errors (`pnpm build`)

## Contributor Checklist (Drips Wave Standard)

- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas (e.g., Soroban math).
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the `/apps/docs` GitBook/Nextra documentation.
- [ ] My changes generate no new compiler warnings (Rust or TypeScript).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
